about: Learn as you play: the lesson each kind of card opens, by lesson id in core/lessons/index.json. A card whose lesson is not in the index is not shown. Openings are not listed: an opening card opens the opening chapter whose title starts its name in the opening table (the longest such title), and shows nothing when there is none. core/test/learn.test.js fails if an id here is not a lesson in the index.
